name: Pet's Reincarnation Life
source:
You were once a pet kept by a human but was abandoned one day and died soon after. After death, you enter a school where animals go to learn the knowledge necessary for reincarnation. At this school, animals of all kinds, not just dogs and cats, appear in human form. One day, you hear a rumor about a 'Room of Truth' said to be within the school. It is said that those who visit this room can learn what they wish to know about their past life. You, eager to understand why they were abandoned, decides to search for this 'Room of Truth'.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.beastschool]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你曾经是人类饲养的宠物，但有一天被遗弃，不久就死了。死后，你进入一所学校，动物们在那里学习转世所需的知识。在这所学校里，各种动物，不仅仅是狗和猫，都以人的形式出现。有一天，你听到一则谣言，据说学校内有一个“真理之室”。据说，参观这个房间的人可以了解他们想知道的有关前世的事情。你渴望了解他们为何被遗弃，决定寻找这个“真理之室”。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.beastschool]Google Play[/url]]
